name: Commander Zilyana

mechanics.name: Standard Attacks
mechanics.description: She slashes with her godsword at twice the usual attack speed when she can reach you, and falls back on a bolt of light at range.
mechanics.counterplay: Keep her out of melee range and pray Protect from Magic. If she closes, swap to Melee and step away.

mechanics.name: Starlight
mechanics.description: The unicorn bodyguard. It attacks with melee and, like Zilyana herself, only lands a hit once you stop moving.
mechanics.counterplay: Kill it first if you are staying still, or keep moving and ignore it.

mechanics.name: Growler
mechanics.description: The lion bodyguard. It attacks with magic from across the room, so it keeps hitting you no matter where you stand.
mechanics.counterplay: Kill it early if you are praying Protect from Missiles, since nothing else stops its damage.

mechanics.name: Bree
mechanics.description: The centaur bodyguard. It attacks with ranged and hits the hardest of the three.
mechanics.counterplay: Kill it early if you are praying Protect from Magic, since nothing else stops its damage.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Jagex's internal name for this boss is GODWARS_SARADOMIN_AVATAR, not Zilyana, the same avatar convention General Graardor's GODWARS_BANDOS_AVATAR follows, which is why a gameval name search for 'zilyana' finds nothing. Npc ids: 2205 is the live boss, 6493 the clan cup copy and 12445 the Deadman breach copy, matching the three-variant pattern already shipped for General Graardor. The three bodyguards (Starlight 2206, Growler 2207, Bree 2208) are in npcIds rather than treated as spawns, because like Graardor's sergeants they are in the room from the start and stay for the whole fight. Animations: GODWARS_SARADOMIN_ATTACK 6967 (melee) and GODWARS_SARADOMIN_MAGIC_ATTACK 6970, both unambiguous gameval names. DETECTION IS ANIMATION AND NPC-SPAWN ONLY, BY DELIBERATE CHOICE FOR EVERY SKELETON IN THIS WAVE. Projectile triggers fall back to a boss-presence gate when the game reports no source actor, and graphic triggers have no source actor at all (docs/DECISIONS.md D17), so an unverified id of either kind can false-positive, and discovery never revokes (D18). Animation triggers only match when played by a tracked boss npc, and npc-spawn is exact, so those two are safe to ship unverified. GODWARS_SARADOMIN_MAGIC_ATTACK_SPOTANIM 6971, GODWARS_SARADOMIN_SWORD_ATTACK_SPOT 7003 and GODWARS_SARADOMIN_LIGHT_ATTK_SPOT 7075 are the spotanim ids to add during the live pass. The three bodyguards detect on npc-spawn rather than on their attack animations, which means they unlock on room entry rather than on the attack: no distinct attack sequence is named for any of them in the gamevals, and the live pass is where that gets upgraded. Their previews use each npc's own standing animation per docs/DECISIONS.md D26 (UNICORN_REWORK_READY 6374, GODWARS_LION_READY 7032, FAIRY2_CENTAUR_READY 4311). Bodyguard attack styles are the wiki's: Starlight melee, Growler magic, Bree ranged. Zoom and shiftY are FitZoom output at the shipped 291x140 box plus the standard 10% margin; none of the five needed the zoom correction the flying and oversized models in this wave did. staticFallback is false on all five; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'Commander Zilyana', matching 'name'. FEEDBACK PASS 2026-08-07 (Andrew reviewed every boss in game): "Godsword Slash" and "Saradominist Magic" are collapsed into one "Standard Attacks". The merged row carries the union of every source row's triggers, so a player who witnesses any of the old attacks still discovers it; the old mechanic ids simply stop matching inside an existing discovered CSV, which docs/DECISIONS.md D18 makes safe without a migration. It keeps the first source row's preview verbatim, since every source already shared a model.
